node.statement: Set S=sigma(U), a unitary by node 1.5. The correction estimates give ||mu(S,U)-S bold-dot U||<=84*epsilon_r and ||S-U^dagger||<=84*epsilon_r. Therefore ||S bold-dot U-U^dagger bold-dot U||<(1+1/64)*84*2*epsilon_r<171*epsilon_r. Since U^dagger bold-dot U=J, the left-inverse defect is below 255*epsilon_r, hence at most 260*epsilon_r.
